verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can reproduce and fix bugs, and that each session gets its own VM with a shell and browser plus computer-use control (clicking, typing, screenshots). That implies it can run and interact with a web app inside its own environment. No documentation shows it attaching to or inspecting an already-running live web application as a debugger. missing for 10: documented debugging of a live running web app (debugger attach, runtime/console/network inspection), an explicit web-app debugging workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant

citations.quote: Devin has access to a full desktop environment — not just a browser. It can move the mouse, click on UI elements, type on the keyboard, take screenshots
The cloud session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, and full repo access
